level_rules.strong_fractals: THE EDGE Strong High/Low (HRL) facts as two separate flags: VC_AT_FRACTAL = RB/SNR of the same TF formed on one of the fractal candles; RAIDED_PRIOR_FRACTAL = a fractal candle was the first strict crossing of an earlier same-polarity fractal; component observations only; Q10 classifications are in thesis_inputs.opposite_side
level_rules.fractals_inside_kl: Fractals of this TF inside a live KL of the same or next higher TF (X-1 trigger geometry); see thesis_inputs.execution for confirmed Fractals inside the active DR
level_rules.kl_events: CLOSED_CANDLES_OWN_AND_LOWER_TF_AFTER_FORMATION: TOUCH inside / REJECTION close back beyond near edge / ACCEPTANCE close beyond far edge / RAID fractal wick beyond, close back; colour and wick share are not criteria
